# Ocean Ecosystem Simulator

> A cinematic, real-time 3D underwater ecosystem that runs in the browser. Hundreds of
> living marine creatures with schooling AI and predator-prey dynamics, rendered with a
> "Cinematic Deep" art direction: volumetric god rays, Beer-Lambert depth grading, and
> AgX filmic tonemapping. Built with Three.js and bitECS.

## What it is
- An interactive WebGL demo / portfolio piece, not a product. Free to view, no account.
- Explore with WASD + mouse (Q/E for up/down, H toggles the UI).

## Technology
- Rendering: Three.js (WebGL2), postprocessing library, custom GLSL shaders
- Simulation: bitECS entity-component-system; FIRA steering + Reynolds boids schooling
- Build: Vite + TypeScript

## Notable techniques
- Per-channel Beer-Lambert underwater absorption + exponential depth fog
- Volumetric god-ray light shafts (billboard columns, animated shimmer)
- Instanced GPU fish with vertex-shader swim animation, countershading, fresnel rim, iridescence
- AgX tonemapping, film grain, chromatic aberration, bloom, vignette
- Cinematic camera flythrough (Catmull-Rom keyframe path)
